name: Ore-Ida Golden Tater Tots (Air-Fried or Oven-Baked)
whyItWorks: Finely shredded Idaho russet potatoes seasoned with salt and par-fried. When baked in the oven or air fryer without added oil, they crisp up on the outside while the interior melts into fluffy potato starch.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Bake at 425°F for 20 minutes until golden. Do not deep-fry in oil to keep fat levels manageable.
watchOuts: Contains par-fried oil; enjoy in standard 3-oz servings.
